## 2026-05-21

### Impact

- **Performance observability.** The SDK now records three milestone timings on every Transact presentation — Time to Load, Time to Initialize, and Time to First Interaction. This gives the team production visibility into SDK performance.
- **More language support.** French is now accepted as a language value, and the SDK automatically defaults to French on French-locale devices when no language is provided.

### Changes

- Recorded Transact timings (Time to Load, Time to Initialize, Time to First Interaction) and emitted them to tracing service
- Added `Config.Deeplink.Step.MANUAL_FALLBACK` for routing users directly into the manual setup / fallback experience
- Added French (`fr`) language support and a system-language option that follows the device locale
- Removed the `publicToken` from the Transact initialize URL; it now flows only through the in-page window object

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.7+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.6+       | 8.6.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle     | 8.0+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.1 - 8.5  | 8.1.4         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |
